audit.whatIsWrong: Both level charts read Vayne/Vayne/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill against a packet levelChart of Skill/Mordekaiser/Mordekaiser/Mordekaiser/Mordekaiser/Vayne/Vayne. The page currently tells the player Vayne wins levels 1-2 (when she has no crit item and Mordekaiser has Obliterate + Indestructible) and that Mordekaiser owns the late game (when Silver Bolts' true damage explicitly beats him — the prose two lines below says exactly that).
audit.why: 50.1% over 1443 games with a hard scaling ADC: Mordekaiser owns the early-to-6 window and Vayne takes it back on items. The existing chart inverts both ends.
audit.corrected: Both layers set to Skill / Mordekaiser / Mordekaiser / Mordekaiser / Mordekaiser / Vayne / Vayne as one atomic paired group, with ratings and the two contradicting phases[N].why lines rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content whys[] are shifted one row early against their own labels: whys[3] sits on the 'Levels 4-5' row but describes Realm of Death (level 6); whys[4] sits on the 'Level 6' row but describes the first-item spike; whys[5] sits on the 'First item' row but describes two items.
audit.why: The level chart renders each why beside its label, so a paying user reads 'Levels 4-5' next to a description of the level-6 ultimate. The spike timings themselves are right, they are just attached to the wrong rows.
audit.corrected: Rewrote whys[3] as a real Levels 4-5 entry (Q ranks, Death's Grasp on a Tumble, Darkness Rise in extended melee), moved the Realm of Death content onto whys[4] with the real 650 R range, and re-anchored whys[5] to her FIRST crit item. whys[6] already described 2+ items correctly.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly tells the player to 'build resists' against Vayne. Silver Bolts (W) deals a percentage of max health as bonus TRUE damage on the third consecutive hit — armour and MR do nothing against it, and stacking HP makes it hit harder. The single most-repeated instruction in the matchup is backwards. Separately, no text anywhere uses the two ranges that decide the ultimate: Realm of Death is 650, Condemn is 550.
audit.why: True damage bypasses resistances by definition, and the percent-max-health scaling means the tankier Mordekaiser builds the more Silver Bolts takes off him. The 650-vs-550 gap is the concrete reason Mordekaiser can ult before he gets shoved.
audit.corrected: Removed the 'build resists' instruction from tldr, winCon, report[0].t and report[1].t and replaced it with the real interaction: ult from 650 to beat her 550 Condemn, and win the game before her items arrive. Added Condemn's real cooldown (20s at rank 1 to 12s at rank 5) and the terrain condition — it only stuns if a wall is behind you.
sources: enemyKit E cd 20/18/16/14/12, range 550, terrain flag

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions flagged the auto-reset tell and nothing on the page carried it: Tumble (Q) is an auto-attack reset, so her burst opens with a wind-up rather than a visible cast.
audit.why: The player watching for 'the ability' reacts a full attack too late. The wind-up is the cue.
audit.corrected: Rewrote dontsFull[0].d — the entry already headed 'Chase her tumbles in the open' but carried only generic filler — to state that Tumble is an auto-attack reset and the wind-up is the cue to back off.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2].text read '...plus E Death's Grasp pull and Death's Grasp's magic pen...' — the same ability named twice in one clause (this is what packet.suspectNames flagged), and the magic-penetration claim is not in Riot's description of the ability, which reads only 'Mordekaiser pulls all enemies in an area.'
audit.why: Per the rule, an ability property absent from the kit text is UNKNOWN, not confirmed. I removed the claim rather than asserting it.
audit.corrected: Rewrote spikes[2].text around the verifiable fact instead: his first magic item lands before her first crit item, and Death's Grasp (E) pulls at 700 range to glue her into Darkness Rise.
